mapper.insert: insert into vpn.chat_session(userId, name, characterId, roleId, createdAt, updatedAt, deleted) values (#{userId}, #{name}, #{characterId}, #{roleId}, now(), now(), 0)
mapper.select: select id, userId, name, characterId, roleId, createdAt, updatedAt, deleted from vpn.chat_session where id = #{id} and userId = #{userId} and deleted = 0

select s.id, s.name, s.characterId, s.roleId, unix_timestamp(s.createdAt) * 1000 as createdAt, unix_timestamp(s.updatedAt) * 1000 as updatedAt, (select left(m.content, 40) from vpn.chat_message m where m.sessionId = s.id and m.deleted = 0 order by m.id desc limit 1) as lastMessage, (select count(*) from vpn.chat_message m where m.sessionId = s.id and m.deleted = 0) as messageCount from vpn.chat_session s where s.userId = #{userId} and s.deleted = 0 order by s.updatedAt desc, s.id desc
mapper.update: update vpn.chat_session set name = #{name}, updatedAt = now() where id = #{id} and userId = #{userId} and deleted = 0
update vpn.chat_session set deleted = 1, updatedAt = now() where id = #{id} and userId = #{userId} and deleted = 0
update vpn.chat_session set updatedAt = now() where id = #{id}
update vpn.chat_session set characterId = coalesce(characterId, #{characterId}), roleId = coalesce(roleId, #{roleId}) where id = #{id}
